app_tagline: Smart Plant Identification, Disease Detection & Farming Early Warning System
home_welcome_desc: An integrated decision-support platform for plant identification, genuine disease classification, live weather risks, and agricultural extension advice.
home_identify_desc: Photograph or upload a leaf/plant image to identify common plant species.
home_crop_desc: Screen affected leaves for crop diseases using genuine MobileNetV2 transfer learning.
home_weather_desc: 5-day live Open-Meteo forecast and automated agricultural weather-risk alerts.
home_care_desc: Personalized watering, sunlight, soil, and nutrient guidance for your plants.
home_pests_desc: Explore visual symptoms like yellowing, holes, or wilting and their potential causes.
home_advice_desc: Explore safe cultural, biological, and extension-verified treatment guidance.
home_schemes_desc: Verified central and state government agricultural subsidy and insurance schemes.
home_history_desc: Review, export, and manage your private on-device crop scan records.
home_crop_safety_text: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) prioritizes cultural and biological controls before chemical intervention. Never apply unlabelled chemical cocktails or spray during windy and rainy weather. Protect honeybees and beneficial pollinators by avoiding spraying during active flowering.
upload_prompt: Upload plant photograph (JPG, JPEG, PNG - Max 10MB)
camera_prompt: Capture a clear photograph of the leaf or plant
analyzing_spinner: Analyzing image with deep learning model...
low_confidence_message: Not sure, please consult your agriculture officer or KVK
field_photo_limitation: Predictions may be less accurate on real field photos. This is decision support, not a replacement for experts.
model_missing_explanation: The machine learning model (model.h5) or class names (class_names.json) are not yet trained on this system. To train the model with genuine PlantVillage data, execute 'python train_model.py' in the project directory.
crop_unsupported_title: Crop Not Supported in Current Trained Model
crop_unsupported_message: Disease detection for this crop is unavailable until the relevant dataset is added and the model is retrained. Currently, only crops with validated training data (such as Tomato) can be analyzed.
confidence_disclaimer: Model confidence is an algorithmic metric, not a scientific or medical guarantee. Always verify with field experts.
scan_saved_success: Scan report saved securely to local on-device history.
forecast_notice: This information presents genuine model forecasts from Open-Meteo, not historical or station-measured observations.
no_alerts_message: No critical weather risks identified for the current forecast period under standard advisory rules.
threshold_disclaimer: Weather alerts are advisory rules based on forecast data, not guaranteed disease predictions.
weather_empty_state: Please enter a location or coordinates above and click 'Get Live Weather Forecast' to inspect forecast and agricultural risks.
invalid_coords_error: Invalid coordinates. Latitude must be between -90 and 90, and Longitude between -180 and 180.
place_not_found_error: Could not find the entered location. Please check the spelling or enter coordinates directly.
consultation_header: When to Consult an Agricultural Officer
expert_review_notice: Content & translation review status: Content compiled from agricultural extension guidelines. Final dosage and chemical suitability require local verification with your Block Agricultural Officer or KVK.
schemes_official_notice: Verify details on the official website. Government rules, eligibility criteria, and financial allocations are subject to change.
err_corrupted_image: Uploaded file is corrupted or not a valid readable image.
err_empty_upload: Empty file received. Please upload a valid leaf photograph.
err_unsupported_format: Unsupported file format. Please upload JPG, JPEG, or PNG images.
err_image_too_large: Image file is too large (maximum size is 10 MB).
err_invalid_dimensions: Image dimensions are too small to detect crop diseases (minimum 64x64 pixels).
footer_disclaimer: Academic Major Project: AI Plant Doctor. Decision-support tool. Not a substitute for certified agricultural specialists.
